assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: a newly generated version-two full-body hero illustration for Arenic, for visual comparison with the previous version.
Input image role: the supplied Forager Daisy image is an identity, costume, palette, and illustration-style reference, not a pixel-preservation edit target. Draw a fresh finished illustration with refined anatomy, expressive hands, purposeful cloth folds, and confident etched linework while preserving who the character is. Keep the recognizable front three-quarter pose and overall silhouette for a fair comparison.
Subject: Daisy, a serene adult human woman herbalist with warm ochre skin, long windblown nearly black hair with dark green accents, an emerald and gold circlet, long earrings and large emerald necklace. Flowing burgundy floor-length robe with broad deep emerald cuffs, neckline and waist sash, fine aged gold edging. She delicately holds a mandrake root with green leaves aloft in one hand and a short curved sickle pointed down in her other hand. Keep her calm dignified face, graceful draped silhouette and all signature jewelry. Two naturally articulated hands; entire lower robe and both shoes visible.
Style: expressive medieval fantasy ink and woodcut/comic illustration, bold near-black outer contours, sharply designed dark shadow masses, delicate etched hatching inside textured flat colors. Restrained forest green, burgundy, ochre gold and warm skin. Maintain a strong readable game-character silhouette. No photographic or 3D rendering; avoid airbrushed gloss.
Composition: portrait 1024 by 1536 pixels. One centered complete character, all hair, leaves, root tips, sickle and shoes fully within canvas with at least 3 percent clear margin. Fill most of the height without cropping anything.
Background: flat opaque PURE WHITE. No checkerboard or transparency pattern, paper texture, gray gradient, ground, cast shadow, scenery, sunburst or halo. The comparison sunburst will be a separate display layer, so absolutely no background decoration in this image.
No text, signature, watermark, interface, border, labels or additional characters.
assets.observations: Narrower face and neck, higher lifted mandrake, more directional robe hatching, altered sickle grip; identity and signature costume preserved.
